question: Should revilers of Shiva or the Kula Bhairava ever receive this teaching?
premises: The teaching must not be given to a reviler of Shiva.
It must not be given to a slanderer.
The context concerns the Kula Bhairava.
inference: Therefore revilers and slanderers in this context must not receive the teaching.
uncertainties: The exact relation of kulabhairave to the prohibition is context-dependent.
plain_english: Not to a reviler of Shiva, O goddess, nor to a slanderer in the matter of the Kula Bhairava.
